quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are dangerous.
The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal.
The recommended speed to drive on a road when conditions are ideal.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but you cannot drive faster. You must drive slower in school zones and work zones. If weather or road construction makes the posted speed unsafe, drive slower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: You hear a siren but cannot see the emergency vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving until you see the vehicle.
Pull to the curb and look to see if the vehicle is on your street.
Slow down, but do not stop until you see it.
Speed up and turn at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the curb and look to see if the vehicle is on your street.
questions.explanation: If you hear a siren but do not know where the emergency vehicle is, pull to the right side of the road and stop. Wait until you are sure the vehicle is not heading toward you.

questions.question: What is the speed limit outside cities and towns if no other speed limit is posted?
questions.correctAnswerText: 55 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit outside cities and towns is 55 mph unless a different speed limit is posted. Follow any posted speed limit signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When driving slower than 45 mph, how far before turning should you signal?
questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes when driving under 45 mph. This tells other drivers what you plan to do. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: When should you leave more space than usual between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: When stopped on an uphill slope.

questions.correctAnswerText: When stopped on an uphill slope.
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, you will have room to avoid a collision.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols or letters. They alert drivers to hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What must you do at an intersection with a flashing red light?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road is blocked ahead.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Then you can go when the way is clear.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic already on the freeway.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: When entering a freeway, speed up on the on-ramp to match the freeway traffic speed. This helps you merge smoothly and safely. Vehicles entering the freeway must yield to vehicles already on it.

questions.question: A second conviction for speeding 55 mph or more, with speed 15 mph or more above the limit, results in a license suspension for ____.
questions.correctAnswerText: 60 days
questions.explanation: If you drive 55 mph or faster and exceed the speed limit by 15 mph or more, and this is your second conviction within a year, your license will be suspended for at least 60 days. You may also face other criminal penalties.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, you should:

options.text: Rely on road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
Know only a general idea of where you are going.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before driving to an unfamiliar area. Do not start driving with only a vague idea of your destination. Check the location on a map before you leave.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right has one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply in this direction.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply in this direction.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead has a sharp curve or turn. Slow down before reaching a sharp curve, just like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic movement. They are usually white with black markings and all drivers must obey them.

questions.question: In cities, about ____ of the people killed in traffic accidents are pedestrians.
questions.correctAnswerText: Two out of every five
questions.explanation: Drivers must be careful around pedestrians. In cities, about two out of every five traffic fatalities are pedestrians. In rural areas, it is about one out of every ten.

questions.question: Which of these helps direct drivers into the correct lanes for turning on some highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows painted in the middle of lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows painted in the middle of lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows in lanes show drivers which lanes to use for specific purposes, like going straight or turning.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross these lines to turn left into or out of a driveway, to enter or exit a highway, or to make a legal U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: Your vehicle's accelerator sticks open while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If the accelerator sticks, the engine will keep running fast even if you release the gas pedal. Turn off the ignition carefully so you don't lock the steering wheel. Then apply the brakes and pull off the road to a safe spot.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can go when it is safe.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are pointing down. What does this signal mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, it means they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: You are turning left onto a one-way street. Which lane should you enter?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane that is closest to your previous lane.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for a highway exit.
The maximum safe speed for a highway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for a highway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended maximum speed for leaving a highway. The example shows 30 mph.

questions.question: When should you slow down when exiting a highway?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you enter the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you enter the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane well ahead of time. Start slowing down only after you are fully in the exit lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This can cause a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set your parking brake and turn your steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes fumes from your vehicle. A leak lets dangerous gases into the passenger area. Fix leaks right away to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: You come to an intersection blocked by other traffic. You should:

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
Sound your horn to make the cars move up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot get all the way through. Wait until traffic clears so you don't block the intersection.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, you should:

options.text: Stop immediately and let the vehicle pass.
Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
Proceed slowly and permit the vehicle to pass.
Keep moving slowly, staying to the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle approaches with lights or sirens, move as far right as safely possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line dividing it. You know this means:

options.text: You are on a two-way road.
You are on a one-way road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a two-way road.
questions.explanation: Yellow centerlines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: Which does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Be aware that tinted windows reduce visibility in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking at oncoming headlights hurts your night vision. Your eyes need time to adjust back to darkness. During this time, you cannot see well.
